input_domain: A valid nonempty row of pre-MinTokens FLOAT values in finite real values plus +/-inf,noNaN;valid stop/force indices;unique field and row epochs. Lowest global ID wins equal maxima,as an explicit required comparator contract.
original_order: if structured AND every masked-row entry is -inf:restore only finite pre-MinTokens x on S
later forced slots overwrite to FLOAT 1e9

single_pass_summary.A: argmax over masked y at indices NOT overwritten by forcing,including -inf with its global ID
single_pass_summary.B: argmax over finite PRE-MinTokens x at restorable stop indices NOT overwritten by forcing
single_pass_summary.H: OR over ALL pre-forcing masked y of y != -inf;includes forced positions too
single_pass_summary.merge: Independent comparator merges for A and B;Boolean OR for H;global ID tie order retained.
single_pass_summary.finish: If structured and not H,merge A and B;otherwise use A. Then merge constant(1e9,forcedID) candidates.
single_pass_summary.empty_candidate_identity: (-inf,+infinite_ID);an empty candidate is not the real all--inf row index0.

no_forcing_lazy_alternative.first: Read only unmasked entries and reduce their maximum.
no_forcing_lazy_alternative.second: Only if all unmasked entries are -inf and structured:read stop entries,select among finite values.
no_forcing_lazy_alternative.otherwise_all_inf: If no restored finite value exists,return lowest global index0;not lowest unmasked index.
no_forcing_lazy_alternative.limits: Data-dependent reference graph;metadata/control/latency/parallelism and demanded logit observers remain charged. Not evidence of actual values.

numerical_scope: No arithmetic reassociation is introduced by max/index/Boolean summary in this declared domain. Native NaN/signed-zero/tie/index semantics and actual FLOAT forcing value must still be bound.
allowed_rewrite: A selected candidate graph can combine row-predicate/reduction and ID production,or split cold restoration after the first reduction. Full mutated-score outputs must still be produced for live observers.
